# Version 4.150.1
> **Focused m150 engine fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 delivers two upstream m150 fixes for text allocation safety and stencil render-pass bounds.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Text allocation lifetime corrected** — Includes the upstream SubRunAllocator use-after-free fix for safer text rendering. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
- **Stencil clear bounds validated** — Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area to avoid incorrect stencil behavior. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

Advances the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package to 14.2.1.1 with no HarfBuzz binding changes.
